A '''d'lis''' was a type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] found on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]],<ref name="GCG" /> an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> The Sullustans found the crystals to be pretty and some [[Gender/Legends|female]] members of the species were named after them.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The d'lis crystals were first mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]]. They were only described in a table of Sullustan female names.<ref name="GCG" />
